title: Mixed Event — Tied By Painful Hope — Episode7 Her Shout Out

meta.Event Outline: With their new outfits completed, MORE MORE JUMP! next gets someone to help create an original song for their next show. The composer gets to work, but then faces some troubles...

rows.Line: Outside of the Miyamasuzaka South Hall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What an amazing show!
Mai looked so cute as Rapunzel too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wasn't sure what a “modern version” of Rapunzel would be like, but I loved how comical it was. The way she became president of a wig company at the end was so priceless!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting us today, Haruka. This ended up being a wonderfully fun break.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you. I mean, I sort of dropped this on all of you last minute.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's fine. It was a good opportunity to be there for a fellow idol and see how she's doing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
She made me want to try even harder!

rows.Speaker: Mai's Voice
rows.Line: Haruka! Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? Mai!
Is okay for you to be out here like this?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Yeah! I do have to get ready for our next showing, but I felt like I needed to properly greet all of you too.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Thank you so much for coming today!
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thank you too!
It was a great experience!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
I'm glad you liked it...!
I sort of tried going the extra mile today because I knew you'll all be watching.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: By the way, how have things been for you?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Pretty good... But we've run into a bit of trouble recently.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Wait, trouble?
You're always free to ask me for help if you think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
But it's pretty complicated, so I'll have to tell you another time...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Okay, I understand...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Um, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I honestly believe that you and MORE MORE JUMP! can clear any hurdle that comes your way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: You're where you are right now because you took every challenge head-on with everything you had, right?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: When I was having trouble, you worried about me and spoke with me the most. Be it me, our group or our fans, you never shied away from anything.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
But when you started struggling...
I couldn't do anything to help...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: But Hanasato and the others in MORE MORE JUMP! were able to do something. They managed to get you back on stage.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: You've all overcome so much already, so I think... No, I know you'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um, Mai...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What would you do when you feel stuck after doing everything you could...?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I'd just keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I'm able to perform in shows like this now, but I can't really be in any musicals because of my throat condition...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: So my options in terms of roles are pretty limited... That frustrated me for the longest time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mai...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: But I want to do what I can for my fans. I may not be able to sing anymore, but there are other ways for me to spread hope to them...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Why?! Why can't I sing anymore?! It's not fair!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I want to keep being there for my fans by being the “idol” I want to be...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: That's probably the reason why I'm standing here right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Me, you, everyone...
I believe we're all capable of doing that because I was!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: So please... Keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mai...! Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not just for putting on a wonderful performance for us... But for encouraging us like this too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know, right?
And we're not about to let her have all the fun of spreading hope to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Oh, I need to go...!
I hope we get a chance to chat more soon!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Bye bye, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Bye, Mai.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mai did such a great job of cheering us up!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's take the courage she's given us to think once more about what we can do for Hasegawa!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: About that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mind leaving it to me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh?
Did you come up with an idea, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I think so...
It's not what you'd consider perfect...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm thinking that I should just go simple and do the one thing I can for her right now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Simple? Also, what thing...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it's simple. I should take this head-on with everything I have.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
As many times as necessary too.
Until my feelings get through.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You and Minori really are power idols, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's important for an idol to have that kind of power.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree.
An idol isn't an idol without a strong heart and powerful feelings!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
So we'll be counting on you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please make it so Hasegawa has fun while making music again...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I will!
Riho's Room

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: No... I still can't do anything...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: What if I stay stuck like this forever...? What happens then...?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Huh? My phone...?
Who's calling me...?
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's try one of these benches.
I'm sure you'll like it since it's so nice out today.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Um...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Kiritani, you went out of your way to call me because of that song, right...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's only a part of it...
There's something else I'd like to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You shouldn't be pushing yourself so hard to create...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...
But I'll be causing all of you so much trouble if I don't finish it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, that's not my point.
I didn't get a chance to finish what I was saying the last time we spoke...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The truth is, Hasegawa, I went through something very similar in the past... So I'm fairly certain that I know what you're feeling right now.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Something similar...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I've never brought it up during any of our streams, but there was a time when my body wouldn't do what it was told even though my mind was ready to act...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a result, I became unable to stand on stage and had to leave ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This may take a while, but would you mind hearing my story...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: About what happened before I joined MORE MORE JUMP!
